title: Dehydration and heat illness
scenario: Dizzy, weak, headache, dark urine, very thirsty after time in the sun without water. Heavy sweating, cramps, faintness.
steps: Move to shade or the coolest place available and stop physical activity.
Sip water steadily — do not gulp large amounts at once.
Loosen clothing and cool the skin with wet cloths on the neck, armpits, and forehead.
For muscle cramps, gently stretch and continue sipping fluids.
Call 911 for signs of heat stroke: hot dry or flushed skin, confusion, fainting, seizure, or the person stops sweating — and cool them aggressively with water while you wait.
Rest before returning to activity, and drink more than you think you need.
do_not: Do not give fluids to someone who is confused or losing consciousness.
No alcohol or heavy caffeine while recovering.
